messages:
olivia_cs: Customer trying to apply promo + free trial but we return 'payment_required' at /v1/promos/apply. They say they completed the 3DS challenge. Payment provider response shows `authentication_status=cancelled` and `status=failed`.
maeve_support: Can you paste the request_id and the raw gateway webhook? also customer id and email pls.
olivia_cs: request_id=rid_20260317_9a4f, customer=user+trial@acme.co, gateway=stripe, gateway_event="payment_method.attached" -> then later `payment_intent.succeeded` never arrives, we only got `payment_intent.failed` with acquirer_reason: "challenge_canceled".
chris_payments: Stripe note: CANCELLED usually means the issuer aborted the challenge or user closed the challenge window. For 3DS2 this can happen if the browser tab is closed or a redirect fails. Does the customer use mobile in-app webview? :thinking:
simon_engineer: We also see a short-lived 502 from our webhook consumer at 2026-03-17T12:03:21Z for that user which might have dropped the followup event. log snippet:
```
ERROR webhooks.consumer - 502 Bad Gateway from /internal/payments/ingest rid=rid_20260317_9a4f
payload: {"type":"payment_intent.succeeded","id":"pi_1Fxxxx"}
```
maeve_support: Ok. Two possible causes: a) issuer really canceled the 3DS challenge -> user needs to retry, b) we dropped the success event during temporary webhook failure -> our state stayed 'requires_payment_method'. Recommend manual grant if customer is priority.
olivia_cs: Customer is enterprise POC, asking to start their trial today. Can we do manual credit while we investigate?
chris_payments: Yes. Ops can apply a one-time trial credit. Use admin tool:
```
# admin CLI
redwood-admin credits grant --customer "user+trial@acme.co" --amount 100 --reason "manual trial grant - 3DS cancel"
```
billing-bot: Manual grant API recorded: grant_id=grant_20260317_001, applied by maeve_support.
alex_ops: I'm going to escalate to payments infra to add a small retry buffer for webhook ingestion and to treat CANCELLED+missing success as a transient path requiring a retry. Ticket: PAY-4389. Assigned to @chris_payments.
maeve_support: Sent customer confirmation and manual credit notice. Also asked them to retry checkout using an incognito browser or full browser (not in-app webview) and provided these sandbox troubleshooting steps:
```
1) In incognito, attempt card tokenization.
2) If you see the challenge, complete it and wait for the 'return to merchant' page.
3) If it times out, screenshot the page and send us the network logs.

Sample curl for reproduction (sandbox):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payment_methods \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \ 
  -d "{ \"card[number]\": \"4000000000003220\", \"card[exp_month]\": 12, \"card[exp_year]\": 2026, \"card[cvc]\": \"123\" }"
```
olivia_cs: Customer replied — they were in-app (Android webview) and closed the challenge. They're happy with the manual trial for now. :white_check_mark:
chris_payments: Follow-ups: (1) monitor PAY-4389 for webhook retry fix, (2) add instrumentation to surface "3ds_aborted_by_user" in the console, (3) docs note about webview caveat. I'll schedule a short runbook update.
maeve_support: Closing thread after manual grant and customer confirmation. Will re-open if they hit issue again."
